# BorderedElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base class for elements with borders and background colors. Provides common functionality for drawing borders and backgrounds.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IBackgroundColor`.

## Properties

- [`BackgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Background color for this element (null = transparent)
- [`Border`](#border): Border widths for each side of the element
- [`BorderColors`](#bordercolors): Border colors for each side of the element
- [`CornerRadius`](#cornerradius): Corner radius for rounded rectangles.
